item.title: Malaysia: Charting a Future-Ready Global Digital Economy
item.description: Malaysia outlined its digital economy strategy at Davos, emphasising data governance, responsible artificial intelligence and sustainable technology-driven development.

item.title: Australia: Advanced Manufacturing Grants Boost Defence Technology
item.description: Australia has allocated over AU$17 million through Defence Industry Development Grants to strengthen advanced manufacturing, digital capabilities, workforce skills and sovereign defence supply chains.

item.title: Thailand: Thai-Language LLM Bootcamp to Drive AI Innovation
item.description: Thailand’s NECTEC and NRCT launched a three-day Bootcamp to train 24 organisations in Thai-language LLMs, enhancing AI skills, innovative smart search systems and effective national research utilisation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Art Technology as a Global Innovation Engine
item.description: Hong Kong is positioning art technology as a global innovation engine by combining immersive systems, artificial intelligence, research-led creativity and policy support to drive technological advancement.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Banking Evolution Powered by Biometrics
item.description: Vietnam is strengthening cyber resilience in banking and payments through widespread biometric adoption, risk monitoring and public awareness, safeguarding citizens amid rising technology-driven fraud.

item.title: Singapore: Robotics Helps Seniors Stay Safe, Active, Independent
item.description: A new community-based rehabilitation robot in Singapore is helping seniors stay active and fully independent by providing intelligent support to reduce fall risks and restore daily confidence.

item.title: Indonesia: AI to Empower, Not Replace, Teachers
item.description: Indonesia is incorporating artificial intelligence into education to enhance learning, introduce coding at the elementary level, accelerate digital transformation, while ensuring teachers remain central and technology is responsible.

item.title: Australia’s Updated Policy for Responsible AI in Government
item.description: Australia is strengthening public sector AI governance, with the National Archives publishing a transparency statement and the updated APS policy reinforcing ethical, accountable and trusted AI use across government.

item.title: Vietnam: Helping Small Firms Navigate Digital Transformation
item.description: Small businesses in Vietnam are rapidly adopting digital systems primarily to meet regulatory compliance, facing high costs, technical challenges and pressure to avoid errors while striving to remain competitive.

item.title: Singapore: Driving SMEs Towards an AI-Bilingual Future
item.description: Minister of State Alvin Tan highlighted how AI is becoming essential for empowering Singapore’s SMEs, improving productivity, building an AI-bilingual workforce and ensuring an inclusive, future-ready economy.
